name: Cyril of Alexandria
bio:
Archbishop of Alexandria from 412 until his death, and the leading opponent of Nestorius; the Council of Ephesus (431), under his presidency, confirmed the title Theotokos, Mother of God, for the Virgin Mary.

His Commentary on John, written before the Nestorian controversy, reads the Gospel in twelve books as a defence of the Son's full divinity against the Arians. He is honoured as a saint and Doctor of the Church in both East and West.
